title: Nothing Like the Movies
author: Lynn Painter
review: Love the sequal to the first book! I was highkey getting mad at Liz at first for being so stuborn. But it eventually worked out and Wes just kept tryinga and trying till he finally got her.

title: Better Than The Movies
author: Lynn Painter
review: Very fun book to read. Liz was my favourite charecter! She was so funny and cringe and poor Wes and to survive her but still fell for her. LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS BOOK!

title: I hope this doesn't find you
author: Ann Liang
review: I love this book so much. The fights between Sadie and Julius were so funny and some gave my second hand embarresment. Love books with happy endings
quote: You were right Sadie Wen. I am comepletely, helplessly obsessed with you. Love, Julius.

title: ASAP

review: Such a great book. I loved the tension between Sori and Nathenial. The book ended in a happy ending which I loved
